scenes.text: Inspironics Apex. One workspace, connecting enterprise applications.

Apex is the shared entry point for the Inspironics products. Instead of separate bookmarks and separate addresses, teams open one workspace and reach the connected applications from there: the Innovation Showcase, SlidesVault, and Inspironics Academia.
Access starts at the Apex sign-in page. A user enters an email address and password, and the page shows each application being opened as part of signing in.

After signing in, the home dashboard presents each application as a card, with a short description and a live status. A recent activity feed summarizes what has happened across the platforms, and quick search lets users jump to a project from the keyboard.

The Innovation Showcase is a gallery of intelligent-infrastructure blueprints, command decks, and architecture systems. Users browse the gallery and open the platform directly from the dashboard, in the same window.
SlidesVault is the presentation library for the organization. Users browse the library, search to discover decks, and open a presentation to view it.
Moving between applications does not mean starting over. From any application, a single link returns to the Apex dashboard, so the workspace always has one front door.
One current limitation is visible in the recent activity feed: the latest Academia synchronization reported a failure. Until that integration is resolved, Academia content may not be up to date.
Signing out ends the session and returns the user to the sign-in page.
Inspironics Apex. One front door, multiple enterprise experiences.
